name: Project tiers and company plan controls
summary: What a project or company is entitled to today and in work in progress. Today the only shipped split is the project's intent: Progress Monitoring projects get 2D progress, Visual Documentation projects don't. A company-level project intent control and contract-type fields exist on development branches only.

roles.note: Setting a company's project intent control is limited to support users through the company update route. Reading the allowed intents is open to users who could create a project in that company.

nfr.open_question: Project intent control refuses creation with "contact support" when the setting can't be read. Is blocking the right failure mode, and how quickly must support respond?

requirements.title: Today a project's intent is the only entitlement split
requirements.statement: A project is either Progress Monitoring or Visual Documentation. On a Visual Documentation project, 2D progress requests outside the zone permissions are refused and new snapshots don't trigger automatic progress. No plan, quota or credit limits what a company creates or how many captures it uploads or processes.
requirements.rationale: Shipped: on api-2d-progress and constructn-api track-3d. The credit model (BILL-FEAT-01 to 03) and project intent control (BILL-REQ-023) are not on track-3d. No credit, quota or billing code was found in capture-api or api-2d-progress (SRC-045).

requirements.title: A company setting limits which project intents can be created
requirements.statement: Each company has a hidden project intent control: both intents (the default), Visual Documentation only, or none. It applies to project creation, draft submission and intent changes; existing projects keep their intent. "None" blocks project creation with a "contact your admin or Track3D support" message. Only support users can set it, and every change is audited with who, when, old and new value and a reason. Customers see only which intents they may pick.
requirements.rationale: Only on constructn-api track-3d-dev@615c0d351599 (model fields on db-models master@9a44863c02b7); not on constructn-api track-3d. Code calls it a "5X interim setup", which suggests it precedes the credit model.

requirements.title: Whether project intent control is on by default
requirements.statement: The switch for project intent control is described as off by default (so companies can be backfilled first), but the code treats a missing setting as on.

dispute.summary: The comment on PROJECT_INTENT_CONTROL_ENABLED says it is off by default; the code defaults it to "true". On a deploy without the setting, restrictions apply at once, before any backfill. Product and engineering to decide in DEC-064. Only on constructn-api track-3d-dev@615c0d351599; not on track-3d.

requirements.title: Companies carry contract type and 5X fields that nothing uses yet
requirements.statement: A company can be marked as prepaid or pay-as-you-go, and flagged as 5X. Only support users can set them, through the company update. No code path reads them yet.
requirements.rationale: Fields are on db-models master@9a44863c02b7 and constructn-api track-3d-dev@615c0d351599; not on constructn-api track-3d, and not on the progress-linked credit branches. Their meaning is not stated in code.
